title: BJP Mahila Morcha leaders detained during milk price hike protest in Bengaluru
seoTitle: Bengaluru BJP milk price hike protest

tea.why: Protesters opposed the recent hike in milk and curd prices implemented by the Congress government in Karnataka.
tea.want: They demanded an immediate rollback of the milk and curd price hikes and better support for farmers.
tea.changed: Nov 2: Police detained Union Minister Shobha Karandlaje and other BJP Mahila Morcha leaders at Freedom Park in Bengaluru.

summary: The BJP women's wing staged a protest at Freedom Park in Bengaluru on Monday against the recent hike in milk and curd prices by the Congress government in Karnataka. Carrying placards and milk cans, the participants shouted slogans against the administration and Chief Minister DK Shivakumar. Union Minister Shobha Karandlaje addressed the crowd, criticizing the state government for increasing the cost of essential commodities and providing inadequate drought relief to farmers. She demanded that the government either withdraw the price increases or relinquish power to prevent a public uprising. As protesters attempted to carry out a march, police detained Shobha Karandlaje and other leaders, whisking them away in buses.
demands: Roll back the increased milk and curd prices
Provide justice and adequate financial support to farmers
response: According to the sources, police detained Union Minister Shobha Karandlaje and other leaders at Freedom Park and whisked them away in buses.

updates.text: The BJP Mahila Morcha staged a protest at Freedom Park in Bengaluru against milk price hikes.
Police detained Union Minister Shobha Karandlaje and other leaders during the demonstration.
